grh_6b6e05ce612b926707a3.title: Justice Is an Uncertain Thing
paragraphs: Fugitive Joe Hahn has escaped to a country where American authorities cannot extradite him, and investigator Dixon can only wait while a new extradition law works its way toward approval. Hahn's local lawyer finds a technical escape route that requires him to spend a few days on a small offshore island before the law can reach him. Hahn abandons even the woman who wants to accompany him rather than risk his freedom. Just as Dixon concedes the legal maneuver may succeed, a sudden hurricane threatens to sweep over the low islands, leaving nature to deliver the justice the courts could not guarantee.
